answer: Embodied Latency Attestation. Each agent identity must answer challenge probes routed over a physical path the operator cannot shortcut: a hardware beacon anchored to a fixed location, like a reef sensor, timestamping round trips. An operator can forge responses only by co-locating real hardware at each claimed site, so ten thousand identities cost ten thousand physical installations plus ongoing power and maintenance. A ridge of independent timing witnesses cross-checks drift, rejecting clusters that share one clock source.
